args.title: Fix weekly summary delivery time for certain time zones
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue with the weekly summary being delivered late to users in Bengaluru, Newfoundland, and Kathmandu is due to a mismatch in timezone handling. The current implementation assumes all timezones fit well with sending summaries at 08:00 based on localHour and SEND_HOUR configurations. Adjustments are needed to ensure that the 'isRollupDue' function accurately calculates the local time for each user's timezone to guarantee the 08:00 delivery.
